name: Kakuu no Kyoukai -hallucination-
source:
"Boundary of Fiction" is a game allowing you to become the main character with a special power. You can take your partner to the fantasy world, manipulate tentacles and attack the heroine.

Hero: Since you are a beginner, I guess …this is it. Looks like you really enjoyed it more than I thought you would.

Girl: No, I did NOT enjoy it. Don’t think I agreed to it, when you used such a nasty trick. I don’t like this at all.

OK. Then, I am going to make you enjoy it. All girls are the same. I can make you go crazy with pleasure.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044307.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《架空的境界》让玩家化身拥有特殊力量的主角。你可以把搭档带入幻想世界，操纵触手袭击女主角。

主角：“既然你还是新手……大概先这样吧。看来你比我想象中享受得多。”

女孩：“我才没有享受。你用了那么卑鄙的手段，别以为我同意了。我一点也不喜欢。”

“好吧，那我就让你喜欢上。女人全都一样，我能让你因快感而疯狂。”

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044307.html]DLsite English[/url]]
